findings.claim: _show crashes kmctl review due with ValueError when a missing object's spec contains a space: git cat-file prints 'SPEC missing', which splits into three or more tokens for a path with a space, so int(header[2]) parses b'missing'. Reachable for any verified file with a space in its path whose history holds a commit that deleted it (git log --name-only lists deletions). Reproduced: commit docs/how/my page.md with a verified entry, git rm it, restore it, run kmctl review due --path REPO.

The repo's own copy of the docs-layout rule, .claude/rules/docs-layout.md:84, still says a page is listed once 'a source changes after it'. It is a hand-kept kmctl copy (last changed with the package copy in 73b59a92), and the package copy's same line was updated here; update it to match.

entries.change: _show tells a missing or ambiguous cat-file header by its trailing word, not by counting fields, so a spec with a space no longer crashes; it is the only place batch output is parsed.
test_docs_page_with_a_spaced_path_deleted_in_history commits, deletes and restores docs/how/my page.md and expects review due to exit 0 with nothing due; it failed with the ValueError before the fix.
The last line now matches the package copies: a page is listed by commit order after its verification commit, for a source change or an edit outside verified and stale_after.
